description: A real 2-page PDF sent as a native document block. The API extracts its text server-side, but the harness holds only base64 — so there is no local substring surface and every citation lands evidence_unverified. This is the fixture that shows the two-stage design's motivating case is NOT solved: the values are right, and nothing here can prove it.
instruction:
The attached document is a two-page supply agreement.

Extract the following.

carrier_name: the legal name of the Carrier, exactly as written.

payment_terms_days: the number of days after invoice date that payment is
due, as an integer.

termination_notice_days: the number of days' written notice required to
terminate for convenience, as an integer.

auto_renews: true if the agreement renews automatically after the initial
term, false otherwise.

For each value, quote the span of the document it rests on and name the page
it appears on. Quote what the document says; do not paraphrase and do not
reconstruct a sentence from memory.

If the document does not state a field, return the absent sentinel and cite
nothing. An honest absence is preferred to an inferred value.

target_fields.name: payment_terms_days
target_fields.description: Days after invoice date that payment falls due.

target_fields.name: termination_notice_days
target_fields.description: Days of written notice to terminate for convenience.
